nodes.label: Sukrit Saha Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Central hub node. Highest betweenness centrality bridging design, data, interaction, and content communities.

nodes.label: Sukrit Saha
nodes.rationale: Portfolio subject and author. Frontend engineer at Sumeru Inc., Bengaluru. Creator of all listed projects.

nodes.label: React 18 SPA
nodes.rationale: Core runtime. React 18, no router/state/animation library.

nodes.label: Vite 5 Build System
nodes.rationale: Build tool for dev server and production builds.

nodes.label: OKLCH Design Tokens
nodes.rationale: Perceptual color definitions: --bg, --text, --muted, --line, --wash, --accent in OKLCH space.

nodes.label: Custom Cursor System
nodes.rationale: Dot + ring cursor with lerp trailing (0.18/frame). Ring scales 1.6x interactive, 2.4x with label. Disabled on touch.

nodes.label: Inertia Scrolling
nodes.rationale: Wheel intercepted, lerped at 0.14/frame. Only sanctioned scroll method.

nodes.label: Magnetic Links
nodes.rationale: data-magnetic elements translate 35% toward cursor on hover. Bound at mount.

nodes.label: Scroll-triggered Reveals
nodes.rationale: IntersectionObserver (0.15 threshold, once). Fade + translateY(28px->0) with stagger.

nodes.label: Hero Word Cycle
nodes.rationale: Cycles TAGLINE_WORDS every 2.6s. 220ms fade/slide out-in. Hover pauses.

nodes.label: Grain Overlay
nodes.rationale: Fixed full-viewport pointer-events:none layer, 40% opacity, 200x200 noise tile, 55s horizontal drift.

nodes.label: Preloader Component
nodes.rationale: Full-screen overlay with SS monogram. Slides up after 650ms with cubic-bezier(.76,0,.24,1).

nodes.label: Awwwards Minimal Design
nodes.rationale: Design philosophy: light warm-off-white, big grotesk type, no shadows, no rounded cards.

nodes.label: Typography System
nodes.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque (display, 400-800) + Instrument Sans (body, 400/500/600). Fluid clamp sizing.

nodes.label: Projects Data
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth: PROJECTS array, TAGLINE_WORDS, TOOLKIT.

nodes.label: App Composition
nodes.rationale: Flat composition of section components. No routing. Owns all global interaction state.

nodes.label: useIsTouch Hook
nodes.rationale: matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)'). Universal fallback gate for all interaction hooks.

nodes.label: Hero Section
nodes.rationale: Full viewport height, 3-line headline with dynamic word cycle, stagger-reveal on load.

nodes.label: Work Section
nodes.rationale: 9 project rows as accordion. Cursor-following preview swatch. Staggered scroll-reveal.

nodes.label: About Section
nodes.rationale: Bio statement + 3-column toolkit grid. Scroll-revealed as single block.

nodes.label: Contact Section
nodes.rationale: Giant mailto with animated underline, secondary social links. All magnetic.

nodes.label: Navigation Component
nodes.rationale: Fixed header with backdrop-filter blur. Wordmark left, nav links right.

nodes.label: Footer Component
nodes.rationale: Hairline top border. Copyright left, back-to-top right.

nodes.label: Interaction Design Philosophy
nodes.rationale: All motion: inline styles + CSS transitions, never animation library. 3 core easings.

nodes.label: Stack Philosophy
nodes.rationale: No CSS framework, no animation library, no router, no state library. Vanilla hooks + rAF.

nodes.label: Agent-Native Workflows
nodes.rationale: Project: prototyping full-stack products with Claude Code.
